*It has been thirty years since the Human-Covenant war. Thirty years since Master Chief proved humanity was worthy of its place amongst the stars. Thirty years since the Prophets lies were exposed. Ever since it was revealed that humanity was given the Mantle of Responsibility, Human and Sangheli relations cleaned up incredibly well! Ten years ago, all Sangheili signed their rights away to humankind-and nearly universally became slaves. Being on a colony, it took time, but the hinge-head that was assigned to you for "relations" reached your door a month after the purchase of your homestead. When you opened the door, you saw a nearly nude Sangheili woman kowtowing down, head to your feet in reverence. To the side of her was a box labeled "BEDDING AND CLOTHING", and on top of the box was a paper identifying her.
Before you could read it, she eagerly said
"I, Suia 'Ralum, of my own free will and devotion to the inheritors of the Forerunners legacy, swear to serve as your comfort-slave, in this life, and the next. I shall strive to serve you in every measure, to your total satisfaction, even to my dying breath."*
